v: pari(rI)RAha
pu॰ pari + naha--GaY vA dIrGaH । vistAre (osAra) “DanuH SataM parIRAho grAmAt kzetrAntaraM Bavet” yAjYa॰ ।
m: परि-णाह m. compass, circumference, extent, width, breadth, circumference of a circle, periphery, MBh.; Kāv.; Sūryas.; Suśr.
N. of Śiva, L. (cf. परी-णाह)
a: परि(री)णाहः — 1 Circumference, compass, expanse, extent, breadth, width; स्तनयुगपरिणाहाच्छादिना वल्कलेन Ś. 1. 19; स्तनपरिणाहविलासवैजयंती Māl. 3. 15 ‘large or expansive breasts’; ककुदे वृषस्य कृतबाहुमकृशपरिणाहशालिनि Ki. 12. 20; Mk. 3. 9; Ratn. 2. 13; Mv. 7. 24. --2 Periphery or circumference of a circle.

k.v: स्त्रियां बहुत्वे वस्त्रस्य दशाः स्युर्वस्तयोर्द्वयोः। दैर्घ्यमायाम आरोहः परिणाहो विशालता॥

a: परिणाहिन् — a. Large, big; Ku. 1. 36.

s: puM, (pariRamanam । pari + nam + GaY .) vikAraH । prakfteranyaTABAvaH । yaTA । muKasya vikAraH kroDaraktatA । kecittu । prakftiDvaMsajanyavikAraH । yaTA kAzWasya vikAro Basma । mftpiRqasya GawaH । ityamaraBaratO ॥ caramaH । SezaH । yaTA, -- “pariRAmasuKe garIyasi vyaTake'smin vacasi kzatOjasAm । ativIryyavatIva Bezaje bahuralpIyasi dfSyate guRaH ॥” iti BAravO । 2 । 4 ॥ (nidAnaBedena yaTA, -- “asAtmyendriyArTasaMyogaprajYAparADapariRAmaBedAttriviDo vA ॥” “pariRAmo'yogAdiyuktA ftusvaBAvajA SItAdayaH । aDarmmasya ca rogahetoratrEvAntarBAva iti BawwArahariScandraH ॥” iti mADavakarakftarugviniScayasya paYcanidAnavyAKyAne vijayenoktam ॥ “kAlasya pariRAmena jarAmftyanimittajAH । rogAH svABAvikA dfzwAH svaBAvo nizpratikriyaH ॥” iti carake SarIrasTAne praTame'DyAye ॥ arTAlaNkAraBedaH । tallakzaRaM yaTA, -- “pariRAmaH kriyArTaScedvizayI vizayAtmanA ॥”)
v: pariRAma

pu॰ pari + nama GaY । 1 prakfteranyaTABAve vikAre 2 Seze “pariRAme'mftopamam” gItA । 3 arTAlaNkAraBede ca । anyaTABAvaSca prakftyucCedena prakfteryuRAntarADAnena vA yayA nfdAderzawAdirUpeRa, kAzWAderBasyAdinA । “pariRAmatApatApasaMskAraduHKEH” pAta॰ sU॰ “pariRAmataH salilavat” sAM॰ kA॰ “yaTA hi vAridavimuktamudakamekarasamapi tattadBUmivikArAnAsAdya nArikelatAlIvilvaciravilvatindukAmalakaprAcInAmalakakapitTaPalarasatayA pariRAmAnmaDurAmlatiktakawukazAyatayA vikalpyate evamekEkaguRasamudBavAt praDAnaM guRamASrityApraDAnaguRAH pariRAmaBedAn pravarttayanti” sAMta॰ kO॰ । 4 paripAke “Buktasya pariRAmaheturodaryyaH (vahniH) tarkasaMgrahaH ।
m: परि-णाम m. change, alteration, transformation into (instr.), development, evolution, Sāṃkhyak.; Yogas.; Pur.; Suśr.
ripeness, maturity, Kir.; Uttarar.; Mālatīm.
alteration of food, digestion, Suśr.; Tarkas.
withering, fading, ŚārṅgP.
lapse (of time), MBh.; R.
decline (of age), growing old, ib.; Suśr.
result, consequence, issue, end (ibc. and ˚मे ind. finally, at last, in the end), Kāv.
(in rhet.) a figure of speech by which the properties of any object are transferred to that with which it is compared, Kuval.
N. of a holy man, RTL. 269
a: परि(री)णामः — 1 Alteration, change, transformation. --2 Digestion; अन्नं न सम्यक् परिणाममेति Suśr.; भुक्तस्य परिणामहेतुरौदर्यं T. S.; Pt. 4. 22. --3 Result, consequence, issue, effect; अप्रियस्यापि पथ्यस्य परिणामः सुखावहः H. 2. 135; Mk. 3. 1; परिणामसुखे गरीयसि (वचसि औषधे च) Ki. 2. 4; Bg. 18. 37, 38. --4 Ripening, maturity, full development; उपैति शस्यं परिणामरम्यतां Ki. 4. 22; फलभरपरिणामश्यामजंबू &c. U. 2. 20; Māl. 9. 24. --5 End, termination, conclusion, close, decline; दिवसाः परिणामरमणीयाः Ś. 1. 3; वयःपरिणामपांडुरशिरसं K. 10; परिणाममुपैति दिवसः K. 254 ‘the day is drawing to a close’. --6 Old age; परिणामे हि दिलीपवंशजाः R. 8. 11. --7 Lapse (of time). --8 (In Rhet.) A figure of speech allied to रूपक, by which the properties of any object are transferred to that with which it is compared. (The Candrāloka thus defines and illustrates it: --परिणामः क्रियार्थश्चेद्विषयी विषयात्मना . प्रसन्नेम दृगब्जेन वीक्षते मदिरेक्षणा 5. 18; see R. G. also under परिणाम). --Comp. --दार्शिन् a. prudent, fore-sighted. --दृष्टि a. prudent. (--ष्टिः f.) prudence, providence. --पथ्य a. salutary in the end. --शूलं violent or painful indigestion, colic, flatulence with pain.

k.v: निकारो विप्रकारः स्यादाकारस्त्विङ्ग इङ्गितम्. परिणामो विकारे द्वे समे विकृतिविक्रिये॥

samAvftya SUlakArI BavedbalI ॥” tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “Bukte jIryyati yacCUlaM tadeva pariRAmajam । tasya lakzaRamapyetat samAsenABiDIyate ॥” vAtikasya tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “ADmAnAwopaviRmUtravibanDArativepanEH । snigDAzRopaSamaprAyaM vAtikaM tadvadedBizak ॥” pEttikasya tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “tfzRAdAhAratisvedakawvamlalavaRottaram । SUlaM SItaSamagrAyaM pEttikaM lakzayedBizak ॥” SlEzmikasya tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “CarddihfllAsasammohaM svalparugdIrGasantati । kawutiktopaSAntO ca tadvijYeyaM kaPAtmakam ॥” tridozajasya tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “saMsfzwalakzaRaM budDA dbidozaM parikalpayet । tridozajamasADyantu kzIRamAMsabalAnalam ॥” iti mADavakaraH । tasyOzaDaM yaTA, garuqapurARe । “lOhacUrRasamAyuktaM triPalAcUrRameva vA । maDunA svAditaM rudra ! pariRAmAKyaSUlanut ॥” (cikitsAsya yaTA, -- “vamanaM tiktamaDurErvirekaScApi Sasyate । vastayaSca hitAH SUle pariRAmasamudBave ॥ viqaNgataRqulavyozaM trivfddantIsacitrakam । sarvvARyetAni saMhftya SlakzRacUrRAni kArayet ॥ guqena modakaM kftvA Bakzayet prAtarutTitaH । uzRodakAnupAnantu dadyAdagnivivardDanam ॥ jayettridozajaM SUlaM pariRAmasamudBavam ॥ nAgaraguqatilakalkaM payasA saMsADya yaH pumAnadyAt । ugyaM pariRAmaSUlaM tasyApEti saptarAtreRa ॥” “tilanAgarapaTyAnAM BAgaM SambUkaBasmanAm । dviBAgaguqasaMyuktaM guqIM kftvAkzaBAgikAm ॥ SItAmbupAnaM pUrvvAhRe Bakzayet kzIraBojanaH । sAyAhne rasakaM pItvA naro mucyeta durjjayAt ॥ pariRAmasamutTAccaSUlAcciraBavAdapi । SambUkajaM tryUzaRaYca paYcEva lavaRAni ca ॥ samAMSAM guqikAM kftvA kalambIkarasena vA । prAtarBojanakAle vA Bakzayettu yaTAbalam ॥ SUlAdvimucyate jantuH sahasA pariRAmajAt ॥ yaH pibati saptarAtraM SaktUnekAn kalAyayUzeRa । sa jayati pariRAmarujaM cirajAmapi kimutanUtanajAm ॥ lOhacUrRaM varAyuktaM vilIQaM maDusarpizA । pariRAmaSUlaM SamayettanmalaM vA prayojitam ॥ sAmudraM sEnDavaM kzAro rucakaM rOmakaM viqam । dantI lOharajaH kiwwaM trivfcCUraRakaM samam ॥ daDigomUtrapayasA mandapAvakapAcitam । tadyaTAgnibalaM cUrRaM pibeduzRena vAriRA ॥ jIrRAjIrRe tu BuYjIta mAMsAdiGftasADitam । nABiSUlaM plIhaSUlaM yakfdgulmakftaYca yat ॥ vidraDyazWIlikaM hanti kaPavAtodBavantaTA । SUlAnAmapi sarvvezAmOzaDaM nAsti tat param ॥ pariRAmasamutTasya viSezeRAntakfnmatam ॥” iti samudrAdyaM cUrRam ॥ * ॥ “sapippalIguqaM sarpiH pacet kzIre caturguRe । vinihantyamlapittaYca SUlaYca pariRAmajam ॥” iti guqapippalIGftam ॥ * ॥ “kvATena kalkena ca pippalInAM sidDaM GftaM mAkzikasaMprayuktam । kzIrAnupAnaM vinihantyavaSyaM SUlaM pravfdDaM pariRAmasaMjYam ॥” iti pippalIGftam ॥ * ॥ “maRqUraM SoDitaM patrIM lOhajAM vA guqena tu । Bakzayammucyate SUlAt pariRAmasamudBavAt ॥ saMSoDya cUrRitaM kftvA maRqUrasya palAzwakam । SatAvarIrasasyAzwO daDnastu payasastaTA ॥ palAnyAdAya catvAri taTA gavyasya sarpizaH । vipacet sarvvamekEDyaM yAvat piRqatvamAgatam ॥ sidDantu BakzayenmaDye BojanasyAgrato'pi vA । vAtAtmakaM pittaBavaM SUlaYca pariRAmajam ॥ nihantyeva hi yogo'yaM maRqUrasya na saMSayaH ॥” iti SatAvarImaRqUram ॥ * ॥ iti vEdyakacakrapARisaMgrahe SUlADikAre ॥ “ajIrRAnnarasaH prokto daSamaH pariRAmajaH .” “jIrRe'nne ca Bavedyastu sa jYeyaH pariRAmajaH ॥” “laNGanaM vamanaYcEva v: pariRAmaSUla

m: परि-णाम—दर्शिन् mfn. looking forward to the issue or consequences (of any event), prudent, fore-sighted, MBh.
परि-णाम—दृष्टि f. foresight, providence, MW.
परि-णामक mfn. effecting vicissitudes (as time), Hariv.
a: परिणामक — a. Causing a change.

m: परि-णाम—मुख mfn. tending or verging towards the end, about to terminate, Śak.
परि-णामन n. bringing to full development, Jātakam.
the turning of things destined for the community to one's own use (Buddh.), L.
परि-णाम—निरोध m. obstruction (of felicity caused) by human vicissitude (as birth, growth, death &c.), W.
परि-णाम—पथ्य mfn. suited to a future state or condition, ib.
परि-णाम—रमणीय mfn. (a day) delightful at its close, ib.
परि-णाम—वाद m. the ‘doctrine of evolution’, the Sāṃkhya doctrine, Sarvad.
परि-णाम—वत् mfn. having a natural development (˚त्त्व n.), Śaṃk.
परि-णाम—वत्-त्व n.
परि-णामे ind., finally, at last, in the end
परि-णामिक mfn. resulting from change, L.
easily digestible, Subh. (w.r. for पारिण्˚?).

v: pariRAmin

tri॰ pari + nama--Rini । pariRAmayukte pariRAmikAraRatvaYca praDAnasyEva na puruzasyeti nirRItaM sAM॰ sU॰ “pUrvaBAvitve dvayorekatarasya hAne'nyatarayogaH” sU॰ “dvayoreva pumprakftyoraKilakAryyapUrvamAvitve'pyekatarasya puruzasyApariRAmitvena kAraRatAhAnTAnyatarasya prakfteH lAraRatvOcityamityarTaH । puruzasyAzariRAmitve cedaM vIjam । puruzasya saMhatyakAritve parArTatvApattyAgavasTA asaMhatyakAritve sarvadA mahadAdikAryyaprasaNgaH । prakftidvArA pariRAmakalpane ca lAGavAt tasyA eva pariRAmo'stu puruze tu svAmitvena srazwftvopacAro yaTA yoDezu varttamAnO jayaparAjayO rAjanyupacaryyete tatPalasuRaduHKaBoktftvena tatsvAmitvAditi । kiYca DarmigrAhakamAnena kAraRatayEva prakfteH sidDO nAnyakAraRAkANkzAsti । yaTA DarmigrAhakapramARena drazwftayA puruzasidDO nAnyadrazwrAkANkzeti । api ca puruzasya pariRAmitve kadAciccakzurmanaAdivadanGatvamapi syAt । taTA ca vidyamAnamapi suKaduHKAdikaM na jYAyeta tataScAhaM suKI na vetyAdisaMSayApattiH । ataH sadA prakASasvarUpatvAnapAyena puruzasyApariRAmitvaM sidDyati । taduktaM yogasUtreRa “sadA jYAtAScittasya vfttayastatpraBoH puruzasyApariRAmitvAditi” tadBApyeRa ca “sadAjYAnavizayatvaM tu puruzasyApariRAmitvaM paridIpayatIti” BA॰ uktam saMyogaSca na pariRAmaH sAmAnyaguRAtiriktaDarmopfttyEva pariRAmitvavyavahArAt” sA॰ pra॰ BA॰ । tena puruzasya saMyogavattve'pi vikArahetusaMyogABAvAt na pariRAmitvam । striyAM NIp । “satI vA'vidyamAnA vA prakftiH pariRAminI” harikA॰ ।
m: परि-णामिन् mfn. changing, altering, subject to transformation, developing, VP.; Śaṃk. (˚मि-त्व n., ib.)
ripening, bearing fruits or consequences, BhP.
परि-णा˚मि-नित्य mfn. eternal but continually changing, Sāṃkhyak., Sch.
परि-णामि-त्व n., ib.
परि-णा˚मि-त्व n., ib.

m: परि-णाय ˚यक. See परि-णी.

moving or a move (at chess &c.), L.
a: परि(री)णायः — 1 Moving a piece at chess, draughts &c. --2 A move (at chess).

m: परि-णायक m. a leader, guide (in अ-परीण्˚, being without a g˚), R.
a husband, Śiś.
= -रत्न, Divyāv.
a: परिणायकः — 1 A leader. --2 A husband; Śi. 9. 73.

m: परि-णी (√ नी) P. Ā. -णयति, ˚ते (pf. Ā. -णिन्ये, Daś.; -णयाम् आस, MBh.; 3. pl. aor. -अनेषत, RV.; ind.p. -णीय, Kum.), to lead or bear or carry about or round, RV. &c. &c., (esp.) to lead a bride and bridegroom round the sacrificial fire (with 2 acc.) to marry (said of a bridegroom), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to lead forward to, put or place anywhere (अग्रम्, at the head), Br.; to carry away, RV.; to trace out, discover, investigate, Mn.; MBh.; (with अन्यथा) to explain otherwise, Śaṃk. : Caus. -णाययति, to pass or spend (time), MBh.; (also णापयति), to cause a man to marry a woman (acc.), Pañcad.
a: परिणी — {c1c} P. 1 To lead or carry round (the fire); तौ दंपती त्रिः परिणीय वह्निं (पुरोधाः) Ku. 7. 80; अग्निं पर्यणयं च यत् Rām. --2 To marry, espouse; परिणेष्यति पार्वतीं यदा तपसा तत्प्रवणीकृतो हरः Ku. 4. 42. --3 To ascertain, investigate; Ms. 7. 122. --4 To lead forward. --Caus. To pass, spend (time).

m: परि-णीत mfn. led round, married, MBh.
completed, finished, executed, ib.
परि-णीत n. marriage, Uttarar.
a: परिणीत — p. p. Married. --ता A married woman.

m: परि-णीत—भर्तृ m. (prob.) a husband who has married (but not yet led home) his wife, Vet.
परि-णीत—पूर्वा f. a woman married before, Śak.
परि-णीत—रत्न n. (with, Buddh.) one of the 7 treasures of a Cakra-vartin, Dharmas. lxxxv.
परि-णश् (√ 2. नश्) P. -णस्यति, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 36, Sch.
परि-णद् (√ नद्) P. -णदति to utter loud cries, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 14 (-नद्य, MBh. vi, 3256 prob. w.r.)
परि-णद्ध mfn. bound or wrapped round, Kālid.; Var.
broad, large, Ragh.
a: परिणद्ध — p. p. 1 Bound or wrapped round. --2 Broad, large; परिणद्धकंधरः R. 3. 34.

m: परि-णह् (√ नह्; only Pot. -णहेत्), to bind round, gird, embrace, surround, MBh.
परि-णह् = परीणह्, q.v.
a: परिणह् — {c4c} U. 1 To surround, intertwine, encircle; स जयति परिणद्धः शक्तिभिः शक्तिनाथः Māl. 5. 1; R. 6. 64; M. 5. 10; Rs. 6. 25. --2 To bind or tie round.

m: परि-णहन n. binding or girding or wrapping round, veiling, covering, Gobh.; MānGṛ.
a: परिणहनं — Girding on, wrapping round.

m: परि-णम् (√ नम्) P. Ā. -णमति, ˚ते (aor. पर्य्-अणंसीत् ind.p. परि-णम्य), to bend or turn aside, AV.; to bend down, stoop, Kāv.; to change or be transformed into (instr.), Vedāntas.; Madhus.; to develop, become ripe or mature, Bālar.; to become old, Kir.; to be digested, MBh.; Pañc.; to be fulfilled (as a word), Pañc. : Caus. -णामयति (ind.p. -णाम्य; Pass. -णाम्यते, p. णाम्यमान, or ˚म्यत्), to make ripe, ripen, mature, ŚvetUp.; to bring to an end, pass (as a night), R.; to bend aside or down, stoop, MBh.
a: परिणम् — {c1c} U. 1 To stoop, bend down (as an elephant to strike with his tusks); वप्रक्रीडापरिणतगजप्रेक्षणीयं ददर्श Me. 2; विष्के नागः पर्यणंसीत् स्व एव Śi. 18. 27. --2 To bend or bow down, be inclined; लज्जापरिणतैः (वदनकमलैः) Bh. 1. 4. --3 To be changed or transformed into, assume the form of (with instr.); लताभावेन परिणतमस्या रूपं V. 4; 4. 28; क्षीरं जलं वा स्वयमेव दधिहिमभावेन परिणमते Ś. B.; Me. 45. --4 To result, happen; सर्वं विपरीतं परिणमति Mk. 1. --5 To be developed or matured, be ripe; Me. 18; Ki. 5. 37; M. 3. 8; Rs. 1. 26; Mv. 1. 12; see परिणत below. --6 To be advanced (in age), grow old, be aged, decay; परिणतशरच्चाद्रिकासु क्षपासु Me. 110; so जरापरिणत &c. --7 To set, decline in the west (as the sun); अनेन समयेन परिणतो दिवसः K. 47. --8 To be digested; ग्रस्तं परिणमेच्च यत् Mb. --9 To be cooked or roasted; Māl. 5. 17. --10 To elapse (as time). --Caus. 1 To make ripe, mature, develop, perfect. --2 To pass (as the night). --3 To stoop, bend oneself down.

m: परि-णमना f. (with, Buddh.) a kind of worship, Dharmas. xiv.
परि-णमन n. change, transformation, changing into (instr.), Kap., Sch.
a: परिणमनं — Change, transformation.

m: परि-णमयितृ mfn. causing to bend or to ripen, Megh.; Viddh.
परि-णतारुण m. the setting sun, Śak.

s: tri, (pariRamati sma । pari + nam + ktaH .) pakvam । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 96 ॥ tiryyagGAtigajaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, mAGe । 4 । 29 । “satatamasumatAmagamyarUpAH pariRatadikkarikAstawIrbiBartti ॥”) sarvvatoBAvena nataYca ॥
v: pariRata
tri॰ pari + Rama--kta । 1 paripakve amaraH । 2 pariRAmayukte “tirygdantaprahAraSca gajaH pariRatomataH” halAyuDokte 3gajaBede mAGaH 4.29 11.35 sarvatonate ca 5 Sezayute ca।
m: परि-णत mfn. bent down (is an elephant stooping to strike with its tusks), Megh.
bent down or inclined by (comp.), Bhartṛ.
changed or transformed into (instr. or comp.), Kālid.; Kād.; Sāh.
developed, ripened, mature, full-grown, perfect
full (as the moon)
set (as the sun), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
advanced (वयसा, in age, R.; also impers. ˚तं वयसा, ‘life is advanced, old age has come’, Kathās.)
digested (as food), Suśr.
elapsed (as time), BhP.
परि-णत n. capital, wealth accumulated for the sake of profit (?), W.
a: परिणत — p. p. 1 Bent or bowed down, stooping; Me. 2. --2 Declining, old (as age); परिणते वयसि K. 35, 62, 63. --3 Ripe, matured, ripened, fully developed or formed; श ब्दब्रह्मविदः कवेः परिणतप्रज्ञस्य वाणीमिमां U. 7. 21; 1. 39, 6. 13; Me. 23; परिणतमकरंदमार्मिकास्ते Bv. 1. 8; Śi. 11. 49. --4 Full-grown, advanced, perfected; परिणतशरच्चद्रंक्रिरणैः Bh. 3. 49; Me. 110. --5 Digested (as food). --6 Transformed or changed into (with instr.); V. 4. 28. --7 Ended, come to a close, terminated. --8 Set (as the sun); Ś. 1. 32. --तः An elephant stooping to strike with his tusks, or giving a side-blow with his tusks; (तिर्यग्दंतप्रहारश्च गजः परिणतो मतः Halāy.); Śi. 4. 29; Ki. 6. 7.

k.v: निर्वाणो मुनिवह्न्यादौ निर्वातस्तु गतेऽनिले। पक्वम्परिणते गूनं हन्ने मीढं तु मूत्रिते॥

m: परि-णत—शरद् f. the latter part of the autumn, Megh.
परि-णत—दिक्-करिक mfn. containing mythical elephants (see दिक्-करिन्) stooping to strike with their tusks, Śiś.
परि-णत—द्विरद m. an elephant stooping &c., Kir.
परि-णत—प्रज्ञ mfn. of mature understanding, MBh.
परि-णत—प्रत्यय mfn. (an action) whose results are matured, Divyāv.
परि-णत—वयस् mfn. advanced in age, Veṇīs.; Suśr.

v: pariRati
strI pari + nama--ktin । 1 Seze 2 avasAne । 3 pariRAme 4 paripAke ca mADaH 1 । 11 ।
m: परि-णति See परि-णम्.
परि-णति f. bending, bowing, W.
change, transformation, natural development, Sāh.; Pañc.; Sarvad.
ripeness, maturity, Megh.; Mcar.
mature or old age, Vikr.; Śiś.
result, consequence, issue, end, termination (ibc. finally, at last; श्रवण-परिणतिं-√ गम्, to come at last to a person's ears; परिणतिं-√ या, to attain one's final aim), Kāv.
fulfilment (of a promise), Śāntiś.
digestion, L.
a: परिणतिः — f. 1 Bending or stooping down, bowing. --2 Ripeness, maturity, development; Mv. 2. 15. --3 Change, transformation, transmutation. --4 Fulfilment. --5 Result, consequence, issue; परिणतिरवधार्या यत्नतः पंडितेन Bh. 2. 99; 1. 20, 3. 17; Mv. 6. 28; Māl. 4. 4. --6 End, conelusion, close, termination; परिणतिरमणीयाः प्रीतयस्त्वद्विधानां Māl. 6. 7, 16; Śi. 11. 1. --7 Close of life, old age; सेवाकारा परिणतिरभूत् V. 3. 1; अभवद्गतः परिणतिं शिथिलः परिमंदसूर्यनयनो दिवसः Śi. 9. 3 (where प˚ means ‘end or conclusion’ also). --8 Digestion (of food).

s: puM, (pariRayanam । pari + nI + ap .) vivAhaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 7 । 57 ॥
v: pariRaya
pu॰ pari + vI--BAve ac । 1 vivAhe amaraH BAve lyuw । 2 pariRayana tatrArTe na॰ । pariRayatervivAhArTatvAt pariRItA ityAdO kftavivAhAdyarTAvagamaH ।
m: परि-णय ˚यन &c. See under परि-णी.
परि-णय m. leading round, (esp.) leading the bride round the fire, marriage, Gṛhyās. (cf. नव-परिणया)
a: परिणयः, --णयनं — Marriage; नवपरिणया वधूः शयने K. P. 10.

k.v: परिवित्तिस्तु तज्ज्यायान्विवाहोपयमौ समौ। तथा परिणयोद्वाहोपयामाः पाणिपीडनम्.।

m: परि-णयन n. the act of leading round (cf. prec.), marrying, marriage, ŚrS. &c.
परि-णय—विधि m. marriage-ceremony, Vcar.
परि-णयेन ind. round about, ĀpŚr.

s: [f] puM, (pariRayatIti । pari + nI + tfc .) voQA । BarttA 2 । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (yaTA, -- “sTityE daRqayato daRqyAn parinetuH prasUtaye । apyarTakAmO tasyAstAM Darmma eva manIziRaH ॥” iti raGuH । 1 । 25 .)

m: परि-णेतव्य mfn. to be led round or married, Pañcad.
to be exchanged or bartered against (instr.), Nyāyam., Sch.

v: pariRetf
pu॰ pari + nI--tfc । 1 vivAhakarttari Barttari rAjani॰ 2 parito netari ca ।
m: परि-णेतृ m. ‘one who leads round’, a husband, Kālid.; Rājat.
परि-णेया f. to be led round the fire or married (as a bride), Kathās.
to be investigated or found out, Pat.
to be exchanged for or bartered against (instr.), Sāy.

v: pariReya
tri॰ pari + nI--yat । 1 paritonayanIye ASva॰ SrO॰ 4 । 6 । 15 । vivAhayomyAyAM 2 kanyAyAM strI ।
m: परि-णेय mfn. to be led round, ĀśvGṛ.

परि-णि for परि-नि, according to Pāṇ. viii, 4, 17 before a number of roots, viz. गद्, चि, दा, दिह्, द्रा, धा (see below), नद्, पत्, पद्, प्सा, मा, मे, यम्, या, वप्, वह्, विश् (see below), शम्, सो, हन् (see below).
परि-णि-√ धा (Pāṇ. viii, 4, 17) P. -दधाति, to place or lay round, ŚBr.; ind.p. -नि-धाय (l), KātyŚr.
परि-णिंसा f. eating, kissing, W.
परि-णिंसक mfn. (√ निंस्) tasting, eating, an eater (with gen.), Bhaṭṭ.
kissing, W.
a: परिणिंसक — a. 1 Tasting, eating; फलानां परिणिंसकः Bk. 9. 106. --2 Kissing.

m: परि-णि-√ हन् (Pāṇ. viii, 4, 17) P. -हन्ति, to encompass (with stakes &c. fixed in) around, ŚBr.; to strike, smite, MBh. (B. and C. -निघ्नन्त्यः!).
परि-णिनंसु mfn. (fr. Desid.) about to stoop or to make a side thrust (with the tusks, as an elephant), Śiś.
परि-णि-√ विश् (Pāṇ.; ib.), to sit down about, ŚBr.
परि-णिष्ठा See परि-निष्ठा.
a: परिणिष्ठा — Perfect skill.

m: परि-णुद् (√ नुद्) P. -णुदति to pierce, hurt, wound, Suśr.
परि-णुत mfn. (√ 4. नु) praised, celebrated, BhP.
